items.description: filing a new sku/location/quantity/inventory_code for a pair with no existing record saves it and shows a confirmation echoing the saved values
the boundary module (app/routes/) does not import the DB session; persistence is confined to the repository module (layering + ORM-only contract)
the app and the Alembic env resolve the DB connection from the injected DATABASE_URL env var, never a hardcoded DSN (config-in-env)
inserting a stock_records row directly against the branch DB with sku, location, quantity, or inventory_code null raises a NOT NULL violation (verifies the migration realized PI2)
inserting a stock_records row directly against the branch DB with a negative quantity raises a CHECK-constraint violation (verifies the migration realized PI3)
submitting a filing with a negative quantity returns a field-named inline error (e.g. quantity must be >= 0), not a generic 400 body

the Alembic migration creating stock_records applies and reverses cleanly (single-step downgrade then upgrade) on an isolated branch, and pre-existing seeded rows survive (verifies PI4; marked @pytest.mark.migration, run on its own ephemeral branch)
a previously filed record is retrieved later and reads back the same stored sku, location, quantity, and tracking code that were filed
refiling an existing (sku, location) pair with a new quantity and tracking code leaves exactly one record for that pair, holding the newly filed values
inserting two stock_records rows directly against the branch DB with the same (sku, location) pair raises a unique-constraint violation (verifies the migration realized PI1)

a filed record's created_at and actor are set once by the service and remain unchanged in the stored row when the same (sku, location) pair is refiled (immutable audit fields, NFR-F1-durability-migrations)
refiling an existing (sku, location) pair lands on the confirmation for that pair, with no error page shown
